'''''StarTour 7''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] that was used by a tourist company. The shuttle was inspected by a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] at a customs checkpoint who identified the cargo as "Tourists," and the craft was permitted to leave the station.
